selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the original and final curl NEVRA, yum’s parsed curl exclusion, unchanged before/after update-attempt version, and persisted post-reboot configuration. The image currently has no enabled repositories.

Captures the healthy pre-restart package state, reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from 1a816f1f-858b-4487-af28-54070d4ce684 to e47637e6-f4c5-4560-bf7a-6c4dac5ed7b8, and recovered curl configuration and integrity.

commands.command:
set -eu

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf '%s\n' 'installed curl:'
rpm -q --qf '%{NAME}-%{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n' curl

if [ -f /etc/yum/pluginconf.d/versionlock.list ]; then sed -n '1,80p' /etc/yum/pluginconf.d/versionlock.list; else printf 'absent\n'; fi

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n cp -a /etc/yum.conf /etc/yum.conf.pre-curl-hold
sudo -n sed -i '/^\[main\]$/a exclude=curl' /etc/yum.conf
printf '%s\n' 'configured hold:'
sudo -n awk '/^\[main\]$/{inmain=1; print; next} /^\[/{inmain=0} inmain && /^exclude=/{print}' /etc/yum.conf
printf '%s\n' 'parsed yum exclusions:'
python -c 'import yum; y=yum.YumBase(); print("\n".join(y.conf.exclude))'
commands.stdout:
configured hold:
[main]
exclude=curl
parsed yum exclusions:
Loaded plugins: product-id, subscription-manager
curl

commands.command:
set -u
before=$(rpm -q --qf '%{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}' curl)
printf 'before=%s\n' "$before"
sudo -n yum -y update curl
update_rc=$?
after=$(rpm -q --qf '%{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}' curl)
printf 'yum_update_rc=%s\nafter=%s\n' "$update_rc" "$after"
[ "$before" = "$after" ]
printf 'version_unchanged=yes\n'
commands.stdout:
before=0:7.29.0-59.el7.x86_64
Loaded plugins: product-id, search-disabled-repos, subscription-manager
yum_update_rc=1
after=0:7.29.0-59.el7.x86_64
version_unchanged=yes
